title: Amateur satellites and orbits
blurb: Explain ascending passes, orbit types, inverting transponders, mode letters, circular polarization and store-and-forward.

E2A01.why: Ascending means the satellite is heading **south to north** along its ground track; descending is north to south.
E2A01.trap: East and west are not part of the definition.

E2A02.why: Inverting means the band is mirrored: positions and sidebands flip, and uplink and downlink Doppler push opposite ways. **All are true.**

E2A03.why: The uplink is **mixed with a local oscillator and the difference product is sent down**, which mirrors the band. It is not demodulated.
E2A03.trap: A linear transponder never detects and remodulates.

E2A04.why: A satellite's mode is its **uplink and downlink bands**, such as U/V.
E2A04.trap: Orbit type and orientation are different things.

E2A05.why: The letters name the **uplink and downlink frequency ranges**, one letter for each band.

E2A06.why: Keplerian elements are the **parameters that define a satellite's orbit**, the input to tracking software.

E2A07.why: A linear transponder passes the whole band untouched, so **FM, CW, SSB, SSTV, PSK and packet** all work.

E2A08.why: Transponder power is shared. A strong uplink **takes downlink power from all other users**.
E2A08.trap: It's about sharing, not telemetry or out-of-band emissions.

E2A09.why: L band is **23 cm** and S band is **13 cm**: microwave satellite bands.
E2A09.trap: 2 m and 70 cm are V and U.

E2A10.why: A **geostationary** satellite orbits once per Earth turn, so it stays over one spot in the sky.
E2A10.trap: LEO and HEO satellites move across the sky.

E2A11.why: Spin modulation and Faraday rotation twist polarization. A **circularly polarized antenna** is unaffected by the twist.
E2A11.trap: A linear antenna fades whenever the polarization turns.

E2A12.why: Store-and-forward **holds digital messages on board for later download**.

E2A13.why: Digital satellites relay messages by **store-and-forward**: hold now, deliver on a later pass.
E2A13.trap: Digipeating relays instantly; it doesn't hold messages.
